label.summary: Claims address policies concerning the Palestinian people, including support for a two-state solution and restoration of U.S. assistance. Multiple claims express support for Palestinian self-determination, including the right of return for refugees and an end to military occupation. Differing approaches are present, with some advocating for a negotiated two-state solution while others support the Boycott, Divestment, and Sanctions movement.
label.title: Palestinian Self-Determination and U.S. Policy Responses

claims.claim_text: Commitment to restore critical assistance to the Palestinian people in the West Bank and Gaza, consistent with U.S. law.
Palestinians in the United States demand the right to resist their oppression.
Demand for freedom for all Palestinians.

Stand in solidarity with the Palestinian struggle against apartheid, colonialism, and military occupation, and for equality, human rights, and self-determination, including the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions (BDS) movement.
Support for a negotiated two-state solution that upholds the right of Palestinians to live in freedom and security in a viable state of their own.

Support for self-determination for the Palestinian people and a political solution to the current crisis premised on the guarantee of basic human rights, including an end to the military occupation, an end to discrimination against Palestinians within Israel, and the right of return of refugees, as outlined in the call for Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions.

SUBJECT, not an ideology, shared stance, agreement, or independently verified fact.

facts or infer positions for groups absent from the examples. If the claims mainly
concern political actors, campaign narratives, or organizing rather than a coherent
policy subject, say so plainly in both title and caveat. Party names can appear
only when the party itself is the subject. Avoid vague titles like 'Policy and Society'.
